plainText:
Lyra's Marill (Japanese: コトネのマリル Kotone's Maril) is one of the main Pokémon owned by . Marill appears in and Pokémon the Series: Diamond and Pearl.

==In animation==
 
 's Marill debuted in An Egg Scramble!, where it was found stuck between two buildings by and . When they tried to help it, it used to force itself out. Afterwards, Lyra came up to them and revealed that Marill belonged to her. Later in the episode, it teamed up with Khoury's to defeat Team Rocket and recover 's Pokémon Egg.

In its next appearance in Gone With The Windworks!, Marill overheard Team Rocket saying that they have something to attend to and wanders off after them. Khoury realized that it was missing, and the whole group went looking for it. Marill was later found at the Valley Windworks.

Its final appearance was in A Rivalry To Gible On!. Marill helped Lyra and Ash search for underground using its sensitive hearing. Over the course of the arc, Marill was shown to be very affectionate towards its Trainer.

===Personality and characteristics===
Marill has a tendency to run off and get itself into trouble as seen in An Egg Scramble! and Gone With The Windworks!. Marill is also close to its Trainer as seen in A Rivalry To Gible On!, when it clings to her back whilst using its sensitive hearing.

===Moves used===
 
 
 

==In the games==
 
When is not chosen as the in HeartGold and SoulSilver, she owns a Marill. It is the first Pokémon she is known to possess. Marill is seen in battle once, when Lyra teaches the player how to catch a Pokémon, and spends the rest of its time following its Trainer. If the player visits Lyra's house, they will see Lyra playing with her Pokémon in her bedroom.

Through phone calls and conversations with the player, Lyra reveals that she thinks her "super-cute" Marill smells like a "dust mop". 

In the English translation, she also informs the player that her Marill has started to evolve into an , although Marill is never seen as an Azumarill. In the Japanese version, Lyra only mentions on how "awesome it would be if her Marill evolved".
